description: This file contains a SwiftUI view component named TailscaleIntegrationSection that manages the Tailscale integration settings in the application. It defines an enum for different Tailscale modes, handles loading and saving configuration related to Tailscale via a ConfigStore, and provides UI elements for controlling and displaying the Tailscale status, including authentication modes and URLs. It also interacts with a TailscaleService external dependency to check status and control Tailscale.

classes.name: TailscaleIntegrationSection
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that manages user interaction for Tailscale configuration within the app.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Asynchronously loads Tailscale configuration from persistent storage and updates UI state.

methods.name: applySettings
methods.description: Validates and applies user-changed Tailscale settings, updates configuration storage, and restarts gateway if needed.

methods.name: buildAndSaveTailscaleConfig
methods.description: Constructs and saves the Tailscale-specific configuration into the overall app configuration storage.

methods.name: restartGatewayIfNeeded
methods.description: Restarts the gateway if it is in local mode and not paused.

methods.name: startStatusTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer to periodically check Tailscale status.

methods.name: stopStatusTimer
methods.description: Stops any active status update timer.
